comment: Parameter 5, Humanize, is left untagged: the line that would apply it to the beat counter is commented out in the source, so the knob does nothing. The STOP, GLOBAL, SYNC and x2 controls are custom buttons rather than parameters. The four CLOCK jacks of a channel carry the same pulse, as do its four SYNC TRIGs jacks. The chain input carries two different things by voltage: below 8V it is read as a whole number whose bits are the clock trigger, the sync and the stop state, and at 8V and above it is read as the tempo in beats per minute (MasterClockx4.cpp:606 to 620).
